samples.title: The Solitary Orbit
samples.material:
TITLE: THE SOLITARY ORBIT

A near-future drama. Dr. Mei Harrow is the last technician aboard the decommissioned
research station Europa-9, three months past the evacuation order, refusing to leave
because the ice below has started transmitting. Her only company is the station's
failing life-support AI and eight-minute-delayed messages from a daughter on Earth who
has stopped answering. As the transmissions resolve into something that sounds like her
own voice, Mei must decide whether she is receiving a signal or losing her mind.

Quiet, interior, shot in long takes. Practical sets, minimal VFX beyond the ice field.

samples.title: Shadows of the Kyoto Mist
samples.material:
TITLE: SHADOWS OF THE KYOTO MIST

A cyberpunk noir set in a Kyoto where the temples have been retrofitted as data
sanctuaries. A disgraced memory-broker is hired to recover a dead woman's final hour,
and finds his own face in it. Rain, neon on wet stone, long silences.

Japanese language. Practical locations, moderate VFX. Intended for festival launch
before a streaming window.

samples.title: The Harbour Line
samples.material:
SERIES BIBLE: THE HARBOUR LINE

An eight-episode crime drama. When a container ship runs aground in a declining port
town, the customs officer who boards it finds forty people alive in the hold and a
manifest that says the ship is empty. Her investigation implicates the union her father
built, the mayor who saved the town, and eventually herself.

Serialised, one case across the season, ensemble cast. Grounded, no procedural reset.
Intended for a premium cable or streaming slot, with a second season if it lands.

samples.title: Late Bloom
samples.material:
SERIES BIBLE: LATE BLOOM

A ten-episode Japanese workplace drama. A 58-year-old salaryman is transferred to a
subsidiary that turns out to be a shell company with one employee: a 23-year-old
programmer who has been running it alone for two years. Neither can report the other
without ending their own career.

Quiet comedy that curdles into something sadder. Single location, dialogue driven.
Japanese language, terrestrial broadcast slot.
